[AVOID] On-screen text, TV channel logos or broadcaster bugs in any corner, character tags or names written on screen, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, readable writing on paper, screens, envelopes or signs; black letterbox bars, rounded frame corners or any border; film cameras, tripods, gimbals, selfie sticks or any filming equipment; any cut or second camera angle; the same person appearing twice, twins, clones or look-alike doubles; a second phone; extra people in focus; distorted hands or fused fingers; face, hair or costume changes; plastic or waxy skin; flashing or cutting to an attached reference portrait or a plain grey studio backdrop; repeated, echoed or stuttered words; an off-screen narrator; background music; Southern or Central Vietnamese accents.
